components.source: bohe-2017-v3, Sec. II.C; Hofmann et al. (2016), Table 1
components.blocker: Bohé et al. cite Hofmann but do not specify which Table 1 fit order they use. The development assembler selects (3,4), while Hofmann et al. identify (1,2) as less prone to overfitting. Pin the actual SEOBNRv4 choice.

components.source: bohe-2017-v3, Sec. II.C and Appendix B; Berti et al. (2006), Appendix E
components.blocker: Bohé et al. specify interpolation of Berti's numerical results, not Berti's approximate analytic fit. Independently identify the exact historical SEOBNRv4 numerical knots, precision, and interpolation rule, or qualify a documented native replacement against whole-waveform evidence.

components.source: bohe-2017-v3, Sec. II, cited initial-condition prescription
components.blocker: Specify initial conditions, tortoise momentum, solver, event/matching semantics, and demonstrate numerical convergence across the domain.

components.source: bohe-2017-v3, Secs. II and VII
components.blocker: Resolve mode/polarization signs, mass/distance scaling, reference phase/time, TD conditioning, FFT convention, and sample support against the named public-binary oracle.
